name: Orbital Service Rover
description: A six-wheel pressurized rover with service battery, panoramic mast and articulated sampling arm.

accessPaths.label: Reach the battery latch through the rear service hatch
Reach the latch vertically through the cabin roof
Reach the latch through the left wheel bay

name: Harbor Container Crane
description: A twin-tower rail crane with traversing trolley, vertical hoist, control cabin and container payload.

accessPaths.label: Reach the trolley drive from the open rail end
Lower a service probe through the tower gap
Reach the trolley through the occupied cabin side

name: Bascule Canal Gate
description: A twin-tower canal crossing with two hinged decks, drive cartridge, counterweight gears and service galleries.

accessPaths.label: Reach the drive lock along the west service gallery
Lower a tool through the tower roof
Reach the drive through the closed deck side

name: Adaptive Radio Observatory
description: A terraced observatory with rotating segmented dome, elevation telescope and removable cryogenic camera.

accessPaths.label: Reach the camera bayonet along the optical axis
Lower a service probe through the dome slit
Reach the bayonet through the occupied lower service room

name: Wildfire Tiltrotor
description: A twin-rotor firefighting aircraft with tilting nacelles, removable water tank and serviceable drivetrain.

accessPaths.label: Reach the tank latch through the open belly bay
Reach the latch through the occupied tail bay
Reach the latch through the side crew cabin

name: Polar Research Station
description: An elevated insulated station with pressure airlock, sliding solar array and serviceable wind turbine.

accessPaths.label: Reach the airlock hinge from the exterior
Lower a probe through the sloped roof
Reach the hinge through the occupied laboratory
